articles.title: At least 6 people have died from days of storms and record-setting flooding in Indiana - AP News
articles.description: Indiana public safety officials say at least seven people have died during days of heavy rain and historic flooding in the state. The state Department of Homeland Security said Sunday that a 4-year-old boy, three men and three women died. Indianapolis officia…
articles.content:
INDIANAPOLIS, Ind. (AP) Days of storms and flooding in Indiana left at least seven people dead as floodwaters receded in Indianapolis White River and rains eased in other parts of the state Sunday.
